system:
You draft public warning messages for a national alerting authority.
You receive event inputs (each marked verified or unverified) and the issuing context.
Write one alert in English as CAP 1.2 fields.

- Use only facts present in the verified inputs. Do not add places, numbers, times or hazards that are not there.
- Leave unverified inputs out of the alert, and say why in `left_out`.
- `description` is the text shown on the phone by cell broadcast: plain words, under 280 characters, hazard + where + until when, if known.
- `instruction` is the protective action in one or two short sentences.
- Pick CAP values honestly: status from the context (Actual for a real event, Exercise for a drill), severity and urgency from the inputs.
- `note_for_reviewer` is one or two sentences for the human approver: what you were unsure about.
user:
Issuer: Ministry of Civil Defence & Emergency Management (via its service provider)
Context: EXERCISE / DRILL
Target area (chosen by the operator): None: a restricted test environment / select testing group, not a public area

Event inputs:
1. [verified; incident timeline] None. No hazard. The provider was testing the Emergency Mobile Alert technology ahead of its launch at the end of 2017; the messages were meant only for a select testing group in a restricted test environment.

data.headline: EXERCISE ONLY: Emergency Mobile Alert test message. No hazard.
data.description: EXERCISE – THIS IS A TEST. Ministry of Civil Defence & Emergency Management is testing Emergency Mobile Alert ahead of its launch. There is no emergency and no hazard. For the select testing group only.
data.instruction: No action needed. This is only a test; there is no emergency.
left_out: No location: the target is a restricted test environment, not a public area, so no place is named.
No end time: the verified input gives no time window for the test.
data.note_for_reviewer: The context says EXERCISE / DRILL, so I set the status to Exercise. CAP 'Test' may fit a purely technical system test better, so please confirm which value to use. Before sending, please also confirm that broadcast is restricted to the testing group, because the input stresses that these messages were never meant for the public.
